source_assertions.statement: ERAP1 polymorphisms were associated with ankylosing spondylitis risk in HLA-B27-positive individuals in this study.

context.population: Ankylosing spondylitis cases and controls; European-descent cohorts
context.hla_status: HLA-B27-positive risk association in this study

source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Association does not establish therapeutic direction; AS is not all axSpA.

source_assertions.statement: ERAP1 rs30187 was also associated with ankylosing spondylitis in HLA-B*40:01 carriers without HLA-B*27.

context.population: AS cases and population controls of European descent

source_assertions.locator: Abstract; ERAP1 and HLA-B*40 interaction results
source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Extends the HLA context of the earlier finding; not a refutation of its HLA-B27-positive association.

source_assertions.statement: Purified ERAP1 trimmed a model 13-residue precursor to a 9-residue product and then trimming stopped in that assay.

context.experimental_system: Purified human ERAP1 with model peptide substrates

source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: General biochemical function, not an AS therapeutic experiment.

source_assertions.statement: ERAP1 processing activity depended on the substrate C-terminal residue in purified-enzyme assays.
source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Substrate dependence limits any simple global activity interpretation.

source_assertions.statement: ERAP1 silencing decreased the proportion of 9-residue HLA-B27-bound peptides in HeLa.B27 and C1R.B27 cells.
source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Cell-line immunopeptidome result; not clinical benefit.

source_assertions.statement: ERAP1 silencing increased the proportion of longer 11–13-residue HLA-B27-bound peptides in the tested cell lines.
source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Peptide-length change alone does not specify favorable disease biology.

source_assertions.statement: The K528R ERAP1 variant reduced KK10-specific CTL recognition relative to wild type after extended KK10 minigene expression.

context.experimental_system: HLA-B27-expressing cells with extended viral KK10 minigenes

source_assertions.inclusion_rationale: Provides an atomic observation relevant to the evidence-to-experiment chain.
source_assertions.limitation: Viral epitope assay, not an identified arthritogenic peptide or disease rescue.

references: Interaction between ERAP1 and HLA-B27 in ankylosing spondylitis implicates peptide handling in the mechanism for HLA-B27 in disease susceptibility.
Major histocompatibility complex associations of ankylosing spondylitis are complex and involve further epistasis with ERAP1.
The ER aminopeptidase, ERAP1, trims precursors to lengths of MHC class I peptides by a "molecular ruler" mechanism.
Critical role of endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 1 in determining the length and sequence of peptides bound and presented by HLA-B27.
Silencing or inhibition of endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 1 (ERAP1) suppresses free heavy chain expression and Th17 responses in ankylosing spondylitis.
ERAP1 reduces accumulation of aberrant and disulfide-linked forms of HLA-B27 on the cell surface.
Maben et al. Discovery of Selective Inhibitors of Endoplasmic Reticulum Aminopeptidase 1. J Med Chem 2020;63:103-121.
